_comment: Our own plain-language summaries (not AMA CPT text). Keyed by code number.
99213: A routine office visit with a doctor for a patient the office has seen before.
99214: A longer or more involved office visit with a doctor for an existing patient.
80053: A blood test that checks several body chemicals at once, including blood sugar and kidney function.
82947: A blood test for sugar (glucose). It is also part of the larger blood chemistry panel.
82565: A blood test for creatinine, a sign of how well the kidneys are working.
85025: A complete blood count: a blood test that counts the different kinds of blood cells.
93000: A heart tracing test (electrocardiogram) with a report.
71046: A chest x-ray with two views.
80061: A blood test for cholesterol and related fats.
83036: A blood test showing average blood sugar over the past few months.
36415: Drawing blood from a vein for lab tests.
